shared_case_group.procedure: After new consumers work individually, combine actual surviving native hits in one two-client short encounter with two identifiable sources and affected targets, one AOE/rapid-hit overlap and one low-frame presentation segment. Reuse existing source/damage/network evidence; inspect only unresolved cross-consumer visual/audio identity, duplicate/priority handling and camera/performance behavior.
shared_case_group.evidence: Victim/source native receipts joined to each rendered/audio timeline; show no wrong-entity reaction, bounded effects, no stolen camera; retain actual frame-time measurements. Pixel-probed10FPS QA is not a performance baseline.
shared_case_group.limitation: Representative minimal scene does not by itself close every all-sources/all-models/all-installations performance requirement. Add only unrepresented consumer/model differences identified by actual results.

capture_reuse_rules: Reuse old raw events/screenshots before planning any execution; prior passing logic does not become untested because presentation remains pending.

Do not rerun crossbow loading/payment, exact40/80 tick weapon cooldowns, shield/Zhenyue/dual-axe stagger clear, nine-accessory closure, bow HUD thresholds or accepted generic network boundaries just to populate this matrix.

No synthetic success packet or direct client-handler call counts as native-trigger evidence. New screenshots must match original frameSerial and actual same-case event timestamps; matching gameTime alone does not prove cross-thread0-frame latency.

Approximate2/4/8tick body effects need animation-clock/state plus timestamped sequence fine enough to observe them. Requested10FPS cap or packet duration cannot establish precise100/200/400ms timing. Do not create a stronger precision requirement than the original approximate request.

Use victim ID from original authoritative event for audit joins. Position-only CF cannot on its own prove body ownership. CV impact-position cue is not automatically target-bound merely because another CV packet type has entityId.

Audio remains NOT_LISTENED in muted QA; source sound enum, invocation log or silent PNG is not an audible pass. No sound is played in this review. A later permitted capture may record loopback without changing speaker volume.
Do not demand new authored audio, shield decal, continuous gold-ring mesh, third-party camera compatibility or all-angle visibility unless actual original requirements/results require it.
Freeze/recoil semantics are local presentation, not authorization for server time stop, forced camera or damage/physics rebalance.
New body/UI/audio changes belong corresponding existing specialist and integration ownership. No handoff was sent or claimed.
